title: feat(plugin-hono-server): compress responses by default (brotli/gzip above 1 KB, never streams)
body:
Fixes #32155

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:内置 HTTP 服务器(`os dev` / `os start` 都用它)默认对响应做 brotli/gzip 压缩:客户端声明接受、正文不小于 1 KB、类型可压缩时才压缩;流式响应(SSE、AI 数据流、流式导出)一律不压缩。
- 为什么改:控制台首屏 JS 与 API JSON 原样传输,`vendor-objectstack` 在线上就是 1.98 MB;实测压缩后 558 KB(-72%),没有 CDN/反向代理的自托管部署首屏流量降到约三分之一。
- 风险与回滚:风险在流式响应被缓冲,以及 ETag/If-Match 保存失败;两者都有测试钉住(流式不压缩、ETag 原样透传)。回滚只需撤销本 PR,没有配置和数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/response-compression.ts`(阈值预读与编码流,`compressResponse` 全函数);`src/adapter.ts`(构造器里挂载的最外层中间件、`runHandler` 中给流式响应打标记的一行);`src/response-compression.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server exec vitest run src/response-compression.test.ts`,预期 23 个测试全过;或在 `os start` 下 `curl -sI -H 'Accept-Encoding: br' http://localhost:3000/_console/assets/` 加任一 JS 文件名,预期看到 `content-encoding: br` 与 `vary: Accept-Encoding`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`src/response-compression.ts`** (new). `compressResponse(c, { streamed })` encodes the answer already in `c.res`. The rules, all in the module docblock:
  - **br or gzip.** The choice follows `Accept-Encoding` (q-values honoured, `*` covers unnamed codings, brotli wins a tie). Brotli quality is 4: the library default of 11 is a build-time setting.
  - **Size.** A body under 1 KB is sent unencoded. A declared `Content-Length` decides this. Without one, the body is read only up to the threshold. A body that ends first goes out byte-identical. A longer body is encoded from the bytes already read, so it is never held whole in memory.
  - **Never encoded:** `res.write()` streams (marked by the adapter), `text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding`, an existing `Content-Encoding`, `206`, `1xx`/`204`/`304`, `HEAD`, `Cache-Control: no-transform`, non-compressible types. The type vocabulary is Hono's own `COMPRESSIBLE_CONTENT_TYPE_REGEX`.
  - **Headers.** `Vary: Accept-Encoding` goes on every response the server could encode. `ETag` passes through unchanged. An encoded answer drops `Content-Length` and `Accept-Ranges`.
- **`src/adapter.ts`.** The constructor mounts the seam as the first `use('*')`, which makes it the outermost middleware. It is an inline middleware that calls `next()` itself, so the existing `adapter.ts:use *` yields entry in the wildcard guard covers it. `runHandler` records the requests it answered from `res.write()`. Nothing in `listen()` or the bound-port path changes.
- **Docs.** The package README gains a "Response compression" section. `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx` gains a "Response Compression" section. The changeset is `.changeset/32155-http-response-compression.md` (patch).
- **No public surface added.** The new module is not re-exported from `src/index.ts`, and no plugin option or env var is added. Compression is always on: see the open question in Acceptance notes.

## Tests

`src/response-compression.test.ts` has 23 cases. Each one speaks raw HTTP through `node:http`, because `fetch` decodes bodies silently.

- A large JSON answer is gzip-encoded under `Accept-Encoding: gzip`, and the same answer is plain without the header. Both carry `Vary`.
- br is preferred, `br;q=0` falls back to gzip, and `deflate` alone gets the plain body.
- JSON under the threshold is sent unencoded.
- A static JS asset served by `serveStatic` is encoded. A `Range` request on it answers `206` unencoded, with its `Content-Range` intact.
- A raw-route `Buffer` answer with no `Content-Length` (the Console asset shape) is encoded, and a strong `ETag` and the `Cache-Control` stay byte-identical.
- An SSE answer written through `res.write()` is unencoded. Its first event arrives while the stream is still open.
- A `text/plain` `res.write()` stream (the AI data stream shape) is unencoded.
- These are never encoded: an already-encoded response, `no-transform`, `image/png`, `HEAD`.
- Both `Set-Cookie` lines survive encoding.
- An encoded answer still streaming when `close()` begins completes, so the graceful drain behaves as before.
- 11 `selectResponseEncoding` cases.

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-hono-server...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server typecheck` at `29556e98`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 507 passed (507)`. The typecheck includes `check:test-typecheck`.
- Ablation 1 (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src subject: the tests import `./adapter` relative, so no dist): deleting `this.installResponseCompressionSeam();` takes the blob from 8b7b347d to 6f413979, and 6 of 23 fail (every encode assertion). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2: deleting `this.streamedRequests.add(c.req.raw);` fails 1 of 23, the `text/plain` res.write stream case. The SSE case stays green because the type rule excludes it independently. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Both ablations ran at the post-merge head before the refactor commit `29556e98` (inline middleware). That commit kept both anchors and the encoding logic.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live, `os start` (production mode) and `os dev`, examples/app-crm.** The Console is the published `@objectstack/console@18.3.0` dist, linked temporarily; `packages/console` was not built or edited. Bytes on the wire:

  | Path | identity | gzip | br |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | `/_console/assets/vendor-objectstack-*.js` | 1,981,952 | 591,232 | 558,420 |
  | `/_console/assets/index-*.js` | 449,687 | 127,602 | 125,407 |
  | `/_console/assets/editor-*.css` | 141,979 | 22,558 | 23,577 |
  | `/_console/` (document) | 22,234 | 8,462 | 8,457 |
  | `/api/v1/discovery` | 3,842 | 1,112 | 1,095 |

  Under `os dev` the vendor bundle goes 1,981,952 to 558,420 with br, and discovery goes 3,843 to 1,091. `os dev`'s HMR SSE (`/api/v1/dev/metadata-events`) still answers `text/event-stream`, with no `Content-Encoding` and no `Vary: Accept-Encoding`, and its `ready` event streams while the connection is open.
- **Runtime compression covers the measured wire cost.** The CLI serves the Console through its own raw route (`createConsoleStaticPlugin`), not through `serveStatic`. The middleware is mounted first on the app, so it covers that route with no edit to `packages/cli`. What remains is CPU per request: about 86 ms br and 133 ms gzip for the 2 MB vendor bundle on a shared box, with no cache. Precompressing at build time (the fenced `packages/console` half) would remove that cost. It is an optimisation, not a defect, so no card is filed. Carrier: none.
- **Why not `hono/compress` itself.** It is available at the installed hono 4.13.12 with no new dependency, but it has three problems here. It produces gzip and deflate only. It encodes any compressible body of unknown length, which buffers the AI `text/plain` data stream. And it rewrites a strong `ETag` to `W/`. Only its content-type regex is reused. No dependency is added.
- **The ETag stays strong.** The record and `/meta` save doors compare `If-Match` against the version token strongly (`crud-routes.ts`, `meta-item-write-routes.ts`, `meta-save-request.ts`). A `W/` tag on an encoded read would fail every save that pins the version it just read.
- **In-process dispatch.** Three in-process callers were audited, and none receives an encoded body today:
  - the Console branding probe already drops `accept-encoding` (`BRANDING_PROBE_DROPPED_HEADERS`, `console.ts:1698`);
  - the form-door probe reads only the status;
  - the action forward's header allowlist excludes it (`API_FORWARD_HEADER_ALLOWLIST`, `action-execution.ts:1277`).
- **Streamed exports are not encoded.** CSV and JSON exports written through `res.write()` go out unencoded. This is deliberate: one rule for every `res.write()` stream. Encoding them would need flush-aware compression.
- **Open question: an opt-out.** Compression is always on and has no switch. Adding a plugin option or an `OS_DISABLE_*` env var would widen the public surface (Clause-②), so it is not done here. A proxy in front of the server sees `Content-Encoding` and passes the body through. Recommendation: no switch until an operator needs one.
- **Gate fixes made in this PR.** `check:tenant-audit-census` could not type `c.res.headers.delete(...)`, so the receiver is now a typed `Headers` local. `check:wildcard-fallthrough` could not resolve a factory-built `use('*')`, so the mount is now an inline middleware that calls `next()`.
- **Governance grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔` over every touched file). Five files have 0 hits: the changeset, `http-protocol.mdx`, `README.md`, `response-compression.ts` and its test. Every hit in `adapter.ts` is pre-existing text this diff does not edit. The lines are 124 and 131 (TLS material: "⭐ BYTES, ⛔ not paths", "⛔ Nothing in this package generates a certificate"), 260, 262, 274, 285, 289, 304, 306, 318, 328 and 332 (the declared-envelope ruling docblock, including "Maintainer ruling (2026-09-03, recorded in commit 65846bc46): one wire"), 354, 458, 488, 717 ("The ruling names direct-mount"), 1174, 1858 ("⛔ The two arms are spelled out rather than assembled from a") and 1920 ("⛔ Never Node's own server-wide sweep from here").

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates at the merged head</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 98 families. All ran. The reconciliation with exit codes reads `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 98 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- The first pass found two real reds, both fixed in this PR: `check-tenant-audit-census` (untyped receiver) and `check:wildcard-fallthrough` (undeclared `use('*')`). Re-run: `✓ check-tenant-audit-census: OK -- 292 write call sites certified …` and `✓ wildcard fall-through: 12 yielding / 0 ratcheted / 6 exempt (18 namespace-claiming mounts)`.
- Four families first refused on prerequisites (exit 3, or a stale spec dist after the merge): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:docs`, `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. After the full build that `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` ran, and a fetch of the pinned fixture commit, all four exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the three touched `.ts` files exits 0. `check-nul-bytes` exits 0.
- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm are CI's.
